# Temporal interaction reference extraction

Activate only for a supplied/reference video, a motion-heavy inspected site, existing HTML interaction or an explicit effect-replication request.

- For video, use the installed `video-to-superprompt` skill to inspect representative beats.
- For existing HTML, use the installed `html-to-interaction-prompts` skill to isolate the relevant behavior.

Translate the output into project evidence rather than copying its superprompt:

`REF-MOTION-* → source → trigger → observed sequence → timing → spatial relation → transferable principle → must not copy → mobile/reduced-motion implication → candidate FX-*`.

01 owns observations and transferable principles. 05 may turn an approved principle into an implementable `FX-*`. The external skill never selects the effect or runtime.
